dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The dorsal surface displays irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-pigmented perimeters with sharp gradient transitions from a dark base coat to high-intensity outer rings and back to darker interior cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of asymmetrical, solid dark-pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily situated in the interstitial spaces between the larger ringed structures on the lateral flanks.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form an asymmetrical quadrilateral; a secondary triad of centroids forms an isosceles triangle just anterior to the rear flipper junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, elongated horizontal band of high-intensity light pigment is visible on the lower right lateral flank, appearing as a significant interruption of the natural maculated pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: The cranial and snout regions exhibit a dense, low-contrast dark pigmentation that differs significantly from the high-contrast topological patterns found on the trunk.
